newsitem.title: UK: Smiths Industries buys Leland for $30 m.
newsitem.headline: Smiths Industries buys Leland for $30 m.

text.p: Smiths Industries Plc said on Wednesday it had agreed to acquire Leland Electrosystems Inc of Ohio for around $30 million.
Leland is a manufacturer of electrical power generators for military and civil aircraft, Smiths Industries said in a statement.

The avionics, medical and industrial products group said the final price depended on valuation of net assets. It intends to pay $13.5 million in cash to Leland's private owners and assume $16.5 million of debt.

Chairman and chief executive Sir Roger Hurn said the acquisition, which is subject to regulatory approval, "confirms our continuing confidence in aerospace, especially in the supply of advanced avionics for the large, successful U.S. aircraft programmes."
He said he was confident Leland would be a net contributor to profits "in its first full year in Smiths Industries."
Smiths said Leland's principal products were high-performance generators which provide electrical power for military and civil aircraft.
In the year to the end of June, Leland posted operating profits of $4.7 million on sales of $36.5 million.
